Magcargo

Fire Rock

Johto · Generation 2

Magcargo is a Fire/Rock-type Lava Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 55 kg. It evolves from Slugma. Its highest base stat is Defense (120), with a base stat total of 430.
